notes: Each eval gives the agent a fixture repo (copy it to <outputs>/repo and treat it as the repo root) and a conversation excerpt. The agent decides what to log, writes files, runs the validator, and writes <outputs>/summary.txt with one line per file created or 'not logged: <reason>'. Dates are explicit in every prompt so filenames are deterministic.

evals.name: product-decision-glossary-term
evals.prompt: You are working in the repo at ./repo (copy the fixture there first and treat it as the repo root). It is 2026-09-12. During a review of the catalog docs the user said: "Always call it `Variant`, never `Option` — Option is what the old PHP shop called it and it confuses the new people. Update the docs." Handle this per the decision-auto-tracker skill, then write summary.txt.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one new file decisions/log/2026-09-12-01-<slug>.md with a 2-6 word slug, status active, Decision of at most two sentences, Source quoting the user with the date; validator exits 0.
assertions: Exactly one new file was added under decisions/log/
The new file's name matches 2026-09-12-01-<slug>.md with a slug of 2 to 6 words
The new file has status: active and no supersedes value
The ## Decision section has at most 2 sentences
The ## Source section contains the date 2026-09-12
scripts/validate.mjs exits 0 on the repo

evals.name: skip-agent-harness-rule
evals.prompt: You are working in the repo at ./repo (copy the fixture there first and treat it as the repo root). It is 2026-09-12.
